sections.title: Introduction
sections.text:
The goal of this Tier List is to inform ARAM players
regarding how strong Heroes are in the current metagame.

sections.title: Guidelines
sections.text:
When you have the opportunity to pick a Healer
and no one else is picking one in your team, we strongly recommend
that you pick the one at your disposal regardless of their tier.
Healing your team is crucial to push the advantage after getting some kills.
As there is no macro in ARAM and your team cannot be punished
for a lack of waveclear, picking a secondary Healer
is often a strong move because it will make your team better at team fighting.
FAQWhich Talents cannot be picked in ARAM?
The following Talents are not pickable in ARAM.
Chromie's Slowing Sands at Level 8
Mephisto's Spite at Level 4
Ragnaros's Lava Wave at Level 10
Raynor's Execute Orders at Level 20
Thrall's Crash Lightning at Level 1
Yrel's Bubble Hearth at Level 20
FAQWhich Heroes are not available in ARAM?
The following Heroes are not pickable in ARAM.
Abathur
Cho
Gall
Leoric
Sgt. Hammer
The Lost Vikings
Some of them may still appear when getting Same Hero Mode in ARAM.
FAQHow does the Same Hero Mode work in ARAM?
There is a 0.5% chance for every player in ARAM to have the same Hero from this list.
Fenix
Jaina
Leoric
Murky
Nazeebo
Ragnaros
Sgt. Hammer
Sonya
Sylvanas
Zagara
When that happens, Heroes will be able to use the Hearthstone without getting its
burst heal and the Hall of Storm will regenerate 3.2% Health and Mana per second.
